Name: Subscription Boxes Mod
Author: Digus
Description:
[b]Current Version: 1.2.0[/b]
[list]
[*]Adds config properties to change the cost of each tier.
[*]Adds dependency with Content Patcher to add the config.
[*]Adds optimal dependency with Generic Mod Config Menu.
[/list]
[b]Objective:[/b]
The objective is to provide a service to help the player progress on a given area of interesting.
I might change the packs items and price to balance things out, based on players feedback.
If people are interested a pack for farmer and fishing areas might be added in the future. As well as a basic tier.

[b]Disclaimer:[/b]
This mod can also be a template for other subscription boxes mods using Mail Framework Mod. You have my permission to copy this mail.json logic to implement your own subscription boxes services and publish it. Just don't copy the mail text, you can write your own.

[b]Installation:[/b][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/]Unzip the Subscription Boxes Mod[/url] into /Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536/]Unzip the MailFrameworkMod[/url] into /Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b]How does it work:[/b]
[list]
[*]Starting on Spring 8 year 1, you will receive a letter explaining the service and on close you will be asked for which pack you want, or to skip the week.
[*]The following day you should receive the tier catalog for that pack and you can pick a pack and pay at the moment, or delay the choosing for the next day.
[*]If you delay, the same letter will be in the mailbox on the next day, with the same options available. You need to have the money to choose an option.
[*]Once you paid for the tier, the letter with your items will arrive the next Friday.
[*]Once you close the pack you will be give the option to keep the same pack and tier(paying immediately), chose another pack, or wait until next week to answer.
[*]If you chose another pack, the tier catalog will arrive the next day.
[*]If you chose to wait, a new letter will arrive next Monday offering the services.
[*]The cycle repeats every week.
[*]If you don't pick a tier until Friday, that week will effectively be skipped and the pack will arrive on the Friday of next week, if you pay on Friday, Saturday or Sunday.
[*]You won't receive items in the pack that you haven't had access already. Like you won't receive Ginger island items before you unlock ginger island.
[/list]
[b]Config options:[/b]
Run the game at least one with the mod installed to create the config.json file. You can edit this file to change the configuration or use Generic Mod Config Menu.[list]
[*]"[b]BasicTierCost[/b]": ([b]500[/b]) Cost of the basic tier in gold.
[*]"[b]StandardTierCost[/b]": ([b]1000[/b]) Cost of the standard tier in gold.
[*]"[b]DeluxeTierCost[/b]": ([b]2000[/b]) Cost of the deluxe tier in gold.
[*]"[b]PremiumTierCost[/b]": ([b]3000[/b]) Cost of the premium tier in gold.

[/list]
[b]Internationalization:[/b]
This mod is compatible with SMAPI support to i18n files. You can translating for your language following this instructions: [url=https://stardewcommunitywiki.com/Modding:Modder_Guide/APIs/Translation]https://stardewcommunitywiki.com/Modding:Modder_Guide/APIs/Translation[/url]
Given the amount of text and future possible adjust needed, I won't provide translations for this mod in the main file. You have my permission to release your own translations files here in Nexus or any other site, just provide a link to this page.

[b]Uninstall:[/b]
Delete the mod from the installation folder.
